title: SAR Extension
description: STAC SAR Extension for STAC Items and STAC Collections.

oneOf.$comment: This is the schema for STAC Items. Remove this object if this extension only applies to Collections.

assets.$comment: This validates the fields in Item Assets, but does not require them.

oneOf.$comment: This is the schema for STAC Collections.

anyOf.$comment: This is the schema for the top-level fields in a Collection. Remove this if this extension does not define top-level fields for Collections.
This validates the fields in Collection Assets, but does not require them.
This is the schema for the fields in Item Asset Definitions. It doesn't require any fields.
This is the schema for the fields in Summaries. By default, only checks the existence of the properties, but not the schema of the summaries.

require_any_field.$comment: Please list all fields here so that we can force the existence of one of them in other parts of the schemas.

fields.$comment: Add your new fields here. Don't require them here, do that above in the item schema.

sar:instrument_mode.title: Instrument Mode
sar:instrument_mode.description: **Deprecated** in favor of `instrument_modes` of the Instruments extension.

sar:frequency_band.title: Frequency Band
sar:frequency_band.description: The common name for the frequency band, to make it easier to search for bands across instruments. The accepted names are listed with their wavelength ranges.

sar:center_frequency.title: Center Frequency (GHz)
sar:center_frequency.description: The center frequency of the radar signal transmitted by the instrument, in gigahertz (GHz).

sar:bandwidth.title: Range Bandwidth (GHz)
sar:bandwidth.description: The range bandwidth of the SAR instrument, in gigahertz (GHz), representing the full bandwidth used in range compression and image formation.

sar:product_type.title: Product type
sar:product_type.description: **Deprecated** in favor of `product:type` of the Product extension: the product type, for example SSC, MGD or SGC.

sar:resolution_range.title: Resolution range (m)
sar:resolution_range.description: The range resolution, which is the maximum ability to distinguish two adjacent targets perpendicular to the flight path, in meters (m).

sar:resolution_azimuth.title: Resolution azimuth (m)
sar:resolution_azimuth.description: The azimuth resolution, which is the maximum ability to distinguish two adjacent targets parallel to the flight path, in meters (m).

sar:pixel_spacing_range.title: Pixel spacing range (m)
sar:pixel_spacing_range.description: The range pixel spacing, which is the distance between adjacent pixels perpendicular to the flight path, in meters (m). Strongly RECOMMENDED to be specified for products of type `GRD`.

sar:pixel_spacing_azimuth.title: Pixel spacing azimuth (m)
sar:pixel_spacing_azimuth.description: The azimuth pixel spacing, which is the distance between adjacent pixels parallel to the flight path, in meters (m). Strongly RECOMMENDED to be specified for products of type `GRD`.

sar:looks_range.title: Looks range
sar:looks_range.description: Number of range looks, which is the number of groups of signal samples (looks) perpendicular to the flight path.

sar:looks_azimuth.title: Looks azimuth
sar:looks_azimuth.description: Number of azimuth looks, which is the number of groups of signal samples (looks) parallel to the flight path.

sar:observation_direction.title: Antenna pointing direction
sar:observation_direction.description: Antenna pointing direction relative to the flight trajectory of the satellite, either `left` or `right`.

sar:relative_burst.title: Relative burst number
sar:relative_burst.description: Identification number that uniquely identifies a burst cycle within each repeat cycle.

sar:beam_ids.title: Beam identifiers
sar:beam_ids.description: Composition of the swath of the SAR acquision referencing the beam identifiers.

^(?!sar:).$comment: Do not allow unspecified fields prefixed with sar:
